name: squire
description: Local control panel for MCP access.

scripts.dev: pnpm run build-ui && concurrently -k -s first -n ui,server,web "pnpm --filter squire-ui run watch" "cargo run --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml -- --no-browser" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:4296 && corepack pnpm --filter squire-web run dev"
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build-ui && concurrently -k -s first -n ui,web "pnpm --filter squire-ui run watch" "corepack pnpm --filter squire-web run dev"
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run build-web && cargo build --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:release: corepack pnpm run build-web && cargo build --release --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml
scripts.build-web: pnpm run build-ui && corepack pnpm --filter squire-web run build
scripts.start: corepack pnpm run build-web && cargo run --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml
scripts.release: corepack pnpm run build:release && sh scripts/package-release.sh
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build-ui && corepack pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.typecheck-web: pnpm run build-ui && corepack pnpm --filter squire-web run typecheck
